Node Discovery

1. What is Node Discovery?
  • Discovery is the mechanism that allows Ignite nodes to find each other and form a cluster;
  • It runs a protocol that detects when nodes join, leave, or fail;
  • Ignite provides two discovery implementations: TCP/IP Discovery and ZooKeeper Discovery;
2. TCP/IP Discovery
  • The default discovery mechanism; nodes form a ring topology;
  • Each node communicates only with its neighbor in the ring to detect failures;
  • Optimized for clusters of up to hundreds of nodes;
  • Uses an IP Finder to get the initial list of nodes to connect to;
  • Common IP Finders:
    • TcpDiscoveryMulticastIpFinder (default) — uses multicast to discover nodes on the local network;
    • TcpDiscoveryVmIpFinder — you provide a static list of IP addresses;
    • TcpDiscoveryKubernetesIpFinder — queries the Kubernetes API for pod IPs;
    • TcpDiscoveryS3IpFinder — uses an AWS S3 bucket for IP discovery;
  • TcpDiscoverySpi discoverySpi = new TcpDiscoverySpi();

TcpDiscoveryVmIpFinder ipFinder = new TcpDiscoveryVmIpFinder();
ipFinder.setAddresses(Arrays.asList(
    "192.168.1.10:47500..47509",
    "192.168.1.11:47500..47509"
));

discoverySpi.setIpFinder(ipFinder);

IgniteConfiguration cfg = new IgniteConfiguration();
cfg.setDiscoverySpi(discoverySpi);
3. ZooKeeper Discovery
  • Designed for clusters of hundreds to thousands of nodes;
  • Uses an external Apache ZooKeeper ensemble for coordination;
  • Scales better than TCP/IP Discovery because nodes don't form a ring — ZooKeeper handles membership;
  • Requires the ignite-zookeeper module: 
    ZookeeperDiscoverySpi discoverySpi = new ZookeeperDiscoverySpi();
discoverySpi.setZkConnectionString("zkhost1:2181,zkhost2:2181,zkhost3:2181");
discoverySpi.setSessionTimeout(30_000);

IgniteConfiguration cfg = new IgniteConfiguration();
cfg.setDiscoverySpi(discoverySpi);
4. TCP/IP Discovery vs. ZooKeeper Discovery
Aspect TCP/IP Discovery ZooKeeper Discovery
Topology Ring Star (via ZooKeeper)
Scale Hundreds of nodes Thousands of nodes
External dependency None ZooKeeper ensemble
Failure detection Heartbeat along ring ZooKeeper sessions
Split-brain handling Segment detection (network segmentation) ZooKeeper handles it
5. Discovery in Kubernetes
  • In Kubernetes, multicast is usually disabled, so you cannot use the default multicast IP finder;
  • Use the TcpDiscoveryKubernetesIpFinder which queries the Kubernetes API server to find pod IPs: 
    TcpDiscoverySpi discoverySpi = new TcpDiscoverySpi();

TcpDiscoveryKubernetesIpFinder ipFinder = new TcpDiscoveryKubernetesIpFinder();
ipFinder.setNamespace("my-namespace");
ipFinder.setServiceName("ignite-service");

discoverySpi.setIpFinder(ipFinder);

IgniteConfiguration cfg = new IgniteConfiguration();
cfg.setDiscoverySpi(discoverySpi);
  • Requires the ignite-kubernetes module and a Kubernetes Service with the appropriate RBAC permissions;
